subject: Duplicate milestone workers remain live; recommend clean single-worker rerun
body: Collision persists after ~11 minutes. PID20636 and PID15956 are both still alive/responding, both CUDA-registered, GPU remains ~100% / ~3.93 GiB, and the shared milestone output directory still contains no panel files. Because the later wrapper deleted/recreated the shared output path after the earlier worker had started, preserving either overlapping run risks hidden cross-run/file-state contamination and also makes timing meaningless. Lane B recommendation is now explicit: under Lane A authority stop BOTH duplicate milestone workers, remove/recreate the milestone output directory once, then launch exactly ONE clean step28-vs-step32 16-anchor + 48-confirmatory evaluation worker and publish its hashes/results before releasing the lease. Lane B will not consume current overlapping-run evidence.
